subject: A labelled diagram of the tape path on the left (loop, capstan, tension roller, record and play heads) with the cycle the play head reads drawn large on the right.
controls: wear: the right-hand trace loses its corners and opens two dropout notches, with the cycle as written ghosted in #4B4B4B behind it (shape, one mutable trace).
wow: the flutter arm resting on the loop's top run swings about its pivot, 0 to 36 degrees (rotation).
length: the tension roller slides right and the loop stretches with it, 80 to 180 px between roller centres (position).
bias: the field lines fringing from the record-head gap into the tape grow from 0.55x to 1.45x (scale).
risks: Hands and screen disagree: P2 wants structure on knobs 1-2 and tone on 3-4, but spool's order puts wear (a trace control) first and length (a structure control) third, so the screen splits left/right while the controls interleave. The left diagram is small at 1:1 (rollers 34 px) and sparse beside the trace; rotating the wow arm lifts its roller off the tape, which is not what wow does physically, so a frames pass should find a truer motion (the arm pressing the run into a dip, say). Wear is the 5-score control but only moves the right half. A ~200 px trace is wider than one mutable outline can be (points within +-64 px of the node), so it needs 2 of the 4 paths.
